problems.basis: Based on https://ascending-it.com/ and https://ascending-it.com/managed-it-support-boise/, Ascending IT is an IT managed services provider with existing payment and ticket portals, not a home-service contractor.

existingSolutions.addresses: Customer support ticket tracking and invoice payment processing

feasibility.explanation: Ascending IT is outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical) and already operates as an IT managed service provider, so no ForgeX solution is recommended.

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is not a fit for ForgeX's segment.

humanReview: No implementation or outreach is recommended; human review is only needed to confirm disqualification in the CRM.

risks.description: Pursuing an IT Managed Service Provider (MSP) falls outside ForgeX's core home-service contractor specialization and risks misallocating sales and delivery resources.

assumptions: The website does not publish service prices or fee schedules, and no ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is outside ForgeX's target segment.

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identity, physical address, core IT/cybersecurity offerings, service packages, external portal hosts, and contact details.
Company background, mission, compliance focus, and verification of leadership naming (none found).
Contact details, support hours, and physical location verification.
Detailed breakdown of managed IT, cloud, backup, co-managed, and vCIO services.
Verification of legal entity disclosures and privacy policy embed script.
Verification of terms and conditions page.
Lead intake form fields and assessment process details.

limitations: The website does not name any owners, executives, or managers.
The website does not state employee headcount or service pricing.
The Privacy Policy and Terms pages load their body text dynamically via third-party scripts (`policies.termageddon.com`), so the underlying legal text could not be inspected.

qualification.rationale: Ascending IT is a B2B Managed IT Services and Cybersecurity provider based in Nampa/Boise, Idaho, rather than an owner-led home-service contractor (HVAC, plumbing, or electrical). Furthermore, as an IT service provider with existing client ticketing and payment portals, it is outside ForgeX's target segment.
